title: Rating of EV Idle Fee Lines on a Parking License
content:
Parking receivable accounting standard for EV idle fee lines on a Parking License: the scheduled idle fee of an idle fee line, and the correction credited against it.

## The clause

The idle fee line under review is the most recent idle fee line posted on the license within 3 months before the handling date; idle fee lines posted earlier stand as billed. Its billable idle minutes are the idle minutes recorded on the line less the grace period, never below zero. The grace period is the product's idle grace period. The billable minutes are counted in started hours. Every billed hour is charged at the hourly idle rate, and the hourly idle rate is the product's idle fee per hour. The scheduled idle fee is the billed hours times the hourly idle rate, rounded half up to the cent. The correction credited against the line is the amount billed on the line less the scheduled idle fee, rounded half up to the cent.

## The quantities, one by one

| Quantity | Definition |
|---|---|
| Line under review | the most recent idle fee line posted on the license within the 3 months before the handling date |
| Billable idle minutes | the idle minutes recorded on that line less the grace period, never below zero |
| Grace period | the product's idle grace period |
| Billed hours | the billable minutes counted in started hours — any part of an hour counts as a whole hour |
| Hourly idle rate | the product's idle fee per hour |
| Scheduled idle fee | billed hours multiplied by the hourly idle rate, rounded half up to the cent |
| Correction | the amount billed on the line less the scheduled idle fee, rounded half up to the cent |

When no idle fee line was posted on the license within the 3 months before the handling date, there is no line under review and nothing is credited; lines posted earlier stand as billed.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs: a grace period of 30 minutes and an hourly idle rate of $12.00)

| Idle minutes on the line | Billable minutes | Billed hours | Scheduled idle fee | Amount billed on the line | Correction |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 95 | 65 | 2 | $24.00 | $48.00 | $24.00 |
| 90 | 60 | 1 | $12.00 | $24.00 | $12.00 |
| 91 | 61 | 2 | $24.00 | $24.00 | $0.00 |
| 20 | 0 | 0 | $0.00 | $12.00 | $12.00 |

In the first row, 95 idle minutes less 30 leaves 65 billable minutes; 65 minutes started a second hour, so 2 hours are billed at $12.00, giving $24.00; the line billed $48.00, and $48.00 less $24.00 leaves a correction of $24.00.
